about.metaDescription: NEONS RUNNING is race discovery, registration and results for the Caribbean running community.
about.title: Race discovery for the Caribbean running community.
about.story1: Finding a race on this island has long meant three Facebook groups, a WhatsApp thread and a Google Form that closes without warning. Runners miss races they would have loved. Organizers fill half a start line and never know why.
about.story2: We founded NEONS RUNNING in 2026 to fix that: one place for every road race in Puerto Rico, with listings, registration, payments, participant management, race-day check-in and official results built in.
about.story3: We are a small team of runners in Cabo Rojo. If something in the product is wrong, one of us has probably already heard about it at a start line.

values.runnersFirstBody: Registration takes under a minute and works on a phone with one bar of signal at the expo. No account walls in front of race information.
values.honestPricingBody: One flat service fee, shown before checkout. Organizers keep the rest, and refunds inside the window are automatic — no email chain required.
values.builtWhereWeRunBody: The team is in Cabo Rojo. We stand at the finish lines we sell entries to, and most features come out of a conversation at kilometre eight.

faq.metaDescription: Common questions about registering, refunds, results and publishing events.
faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.introPre: Everything runners and organizers ask most. If your question is not here,
faq.stillStuckBody: Race-day questions get answered fastest by the organizer on the event page. Everything else comes to us.

items.q: Do I need an account to register?
items.a: You can browse every race and read the full event information without an account. Registering creates one, because we need somewhere to keep your bib, your waiver and your results.
Yes. On the runner information step, enter their details rather than yours. The confirmation and bib go to the email you enter there, and the receipt goes to you.

items.q: When do I get my bib number?
items.a: Immediately. Your bib appears on the confirmation screen and on your profile. Physical bibs are collected at the expo or on race morning, depending on the event.

items.q: What if a race is full?
items.a: Full races show a waitlist button instead of Register. If a spot opens, waitlisted runners are offered it in order and have 24 hours to claim it.
A flat $2.90 per registration, shown in the order summary before you pay. There is no percentage cut on top, and no fee at all on free events.
Cancellations more than 14 days before race day are refunded in full, automatically. Inside 14 days it is at the organizer's discretion — the refund policy on each event page states which applies.

items.q: What happens if a race is cancelled?
items.a: If an organizer cancels, every entry is refunded in full including the service fee, and you are notified by email and in the app. See the cancellation policy for weather postponements.
Show the QR code on your race pass at the check-in tent. It works offline once you have opened it, so no signal at the start village is fine.
Within two hours of the last finisher for chip-timed races. You get a notification the moment yours is live, with your splits, placings and a share card.

items.q: My result is wrong. What now?
items.a: Contact the organizer from the event page — they hold the timing data and can correct it. Corrections propagate to your profile automatically.

items.q: What does it cost to list a race?
items.a: Nothing to list. Runners pay the flat service fee at checkout, and payouts land in your account within five business days of race day.

items.q: Can I move from runner to organizer?
items.a: Yes — switch on organizer tools from your settings. You never need a second account, and your runner profile and results stay exactly as they are.

legal.disclaimer: This policy is written for a product demonstration. Before NEONS RUNNING takes real money, have it reviewed by counsel licensed in Puerto Rico.
